title: Switching from COD to a Net term unlocks Credit Limit at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Choose "Net 30" in Credit Terms.
  3. Type 1200 in Credit Limit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.
  • Credit Terms reads COD and Credit Limit shows $0.00, disabled.

Step 2:

  • Credit Limit becomes editable and still reads $0.00.

Step 3:

  • Credit Limit reads 1200.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R5: “For any other term, Credit Limit is editable, as on Edit Customer today. Switching from COD or Credit Hold to another term leaves the limit at $0.00 until the user enters one.”
  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”
